title: Two Names, One Room  (Dos nombres, una habitación)

segments.t: El miércoles por la tarde, mientras anochece sobre Portland, Arthur sale de su despacho pálido sosteniendo tanto la tableta como el libro de papel de Graham. Hannah y Graham levantan la vista al instante. Escucha primero.
Graham... Hannah... please tell me room six is free tonight.
No, Arthur, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.
Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight has wet paint.
Oh, disaster! Yesterday I took a phone booking on the tablet without my glasses!
Wait, let me look at the tablet screen and the paper book together.
Let me guess. You promised somebody a room we do not have?
Arthur! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest into room seven!
And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening, in forty minutes!
Told you that tablet is a trap.
It is raining outside and every hotel on our street is full! What do we do?
Wait, what is on the third floor above the stairs?
The old sunny attic study... follow me, quickly!
Revisemos línea por línea qué ha descubierto Arthur.
Graham... Hannah... please tell me room six is free tonight.
'Graham... Hannah... por favor díganme que la habitación seis está libre esta noche.'
No, Arthur, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.
'No, Arthur, la pareja del sur se registró en la habitación seis hace una hora.'
Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight has wet paint.
'Todas las llaves de la uno a la siete están ocupadas, y la habitación ocho tiene pintura fresca.'
Oh, disaster! Yesterday I took a phone booking on the tablet without my glasses!
'¡Qué desastre! ¡Ayer anoté una reserva telefónica en la tableta sin mis gafas!'
Wait, let me look at the tablet screen and the paper book together.
'Espera, déjame mirar juntos la pantalla de la tableta y el libro de papel.'
Let me guess. You promised somebody a room we do not have?
'Déjame adivinar. ¿Le prometiste a alguien una habitación que no tenemos?'
Arthur! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest into room seven!
'¡Arthur! ¡La habitación siete ya está ocupada y reservaste a un segundo huésped en la habitación siete!'
And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening, in forty minutes!
'¡Y llega aquí a las ocho de la tarde, dentro de cuarenta minutos!'
Told you that tablet is a trap.
'Te dije que esa tableta es una trampa.'
It is raining outside and every hotel on our street is full! What do we do?
'¡Está lloviendo afuera y todos los hoteles de nuestra calle están llenos! ¿Qué hacemos?'
Wait, what is on the third floor above the stairs?
'Espera, ¿qué hay en el tercer piso arriba de las escaleras?'
The old sunny attic study... follow me, quickly!
'El viejo estudio soleado del ático... ¡sígueme, rápido!'
Volvamos a oír toda la escena a velocidad natural.
Graham... Hannah... please tell me room six is free tonight.
No, Arthur, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.
Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight has wet paint.
Oh, disaster! Yesterday I took a phone booking on the tablet without my glasses!
Wait, let me look at the tablet screen and the paper book together.
Let me guess. You promised somebody a room we do not have?
Arthur! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest into room seven!
And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening, in forty minutes!
Told you that tablet is a trap.
It is raining outside and every hotel on our street is full! What do we do?
Wait, what is on the third floor above the stairs?
The old sunny attic study... follow me, quickly!

Dos huéspedes reservados en la habitación siete, lluvia afuera y solo cuarenta minutos antes del tren de las ocho. ¡Así concluye el episodio dos; acompáñanos en el episodio tres para ver si el ático logra salvar la noche!
See you tomorrow!
